taxonomic_note: Current Kew/POWO accepts Opuntia gilvescens separately. Historical O. phaeacantha var. major maps here, so older broad phaeacantha records cannot be transferred automatically.
look_here_first: Treat this first as a taxon-concept card rather than a finished local key. Confirm current O. gilvescens identity before using historical phaeacantha labels, and prioritize pads, spines, flower, and fruit together when later diagnostic material is added.

project_inclusion.target_zone_status: UNRESOLVED TAXON CONCEPT — USER APPROVED LEARNER INCLUSION
project_inclusion.range_basis: Modern taxonomy supports a distinct Texas concept, but the project has not locked three exact target-zone counties under that strict concept.

approval_exception.reason: Private learner inclusion is allowed while the taxon/range HOLD remains explicit.

best_field_traits: flower color and structure should be paired with pad/spine traits
fruit characters should be used with vegetative traits
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Do not separate O. gilvescens from O. phaeacantha using an old label alone. Historical broad phaeacantha treatments are part of the confusion.

comparisons.key_distinctions: This card intentionally remains concept-first. Use modern identified material and a complete pad/spine/flower/fruit character set before assigning a field plant.

diagnostic_image_needs: direct comparison with strict O. phaeacantha
photo_note: Diagnostic morphology remains intentionally provisional; prioritize expert-verified modern-concept images before expanding this card.
